subject.title: fix(msteams): emit native cjs runtime entrypoints

question: Should `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` become the supported package metadata contract for official plugins that require native CommonJS runtime entrypoints?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but adding a permanent build-mode key changes the official plugin packaging contract and requires explicit owner intent that source inspection and CI cannot supply.

options.title: Adopt opt-in CJS
options.body: Accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` after packed-package execution proof confirms both Microsoft Teams runtime and setup loading.

options.title: Keep runtime builds ESM-only
options.body: Decline the new metadata key and address Microsoft Teams startup through loader, bundling, or packaging changes instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt opt-in CJS
recommendation.body: Accept `runtimeFormat: "cjs"` after packed-package execution proof confirms both Microsoft Teams runtime and setup loading.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available history-backed owner for the package-local runtime and manifest pipeline that would own this contract.
